purpose: Establish missing RF/CNN baselines and test complementary representations on the existing matched 695-person GDI task
outer: Reuse original five outer folds: train556/evaluate139 people
inner: Reuse actual saved CPU PLS inner_assignment per outer fold: train417/validate139. This differs from the four original-fold inner splits in the prepared GPU CNN bundle; outer evaluation people remain identical.
training_weight: records equal, two outputs jointly fitted; evaluation first averages records and sides within each person, then people equally
phase_order: raw-coordinate CNN baseline and fixed prediction averages
frozen MotionBERT frame features plus the same CNN topology

RF.selection: pooled inner person-MAE, first candidate breaks ties

coordinate_summaries: Per-joint observed xy mean/std/mean absolute adjacent change, mean confidence and observed fraction; bilateral 2D knee angle mean/std and ankle-relative displacement summaries. All are normalized image-coordinate proxies, not measured physical speed or clinical joint angles. All-missing summary is zero plus explicit observed fraction; no modification of source input.

CNN.source: Reuse prepared mobile-gaitlab-inspired six-convolution PyTorch model and training implementation
CNN.selection: earliest minimum of four inner person-MAE curves
CNN.resume: epoch checkpoints; same protocol and identity required

temporal_fusion: Frozen original MotionBERT -> average joints only -> 124x512 features -> same six-convolution CNN; change only first convolution input channels 51 to 512. Encoder is never trained. Temporal vectors are not the 512-dimension time-averaged cache.
averaging_rule: 50:50 in original GDI points; no learned weights, clipping, calibration or outer-evaluation method selection

uncertainty.scope: exploratory conditional OOF intervals; development reuse, not independent final validation

interpretation: New matched-input adaptations, not reproduction of an unavailable teammate experiment or original-paper full-video performance. Compare standalone and combined candidates; do not adopt a winner from outer development outcomes.
